scope: Literal column 2 from every nonempty original raw annotation row in all 47 PINNS clips, before resampling or treatment of ID, radius, or confidence. Each row had 12 columns.
interpretation: These labels do not support bicycle, scooter, motorcycle or transport mode distinctions inside the two published classes. Raw label absence does not establish street-level physical absence. Model reserved type rows 3/4 are not annotations.

independent_input_census.source_time_rule: official frame = 3*k + 1; five source times at/preceding anchor; 35 complete target-person samples.
